summary: Iteration 10 — Backup & Restore data-integrity fix validated end-to-end. Built /app/backend/tests/test_backup_restore.py (8 tests, all PASS in 31s) covering: dynamic collection enumeration (future-proof — proven by injecting a brand-new collection BEFORE backup and seeing it captured), file binary capture (SHA256-verified base64 round-trip in payload['files']), end-to-end file restore (upload PNG → backup → delete files-collection doc → /api/files returns 404 → restore → /api/files returns SAME bytes, SHA256 match), partial-restore detection (tampered manifest with file_count+999 → HTTP 409 'verification FAILED' + safety_backup_id), safety backup is itself version=2 with manifest, restore does NOT delete pre-existing backups (BACKUP_EXCLUDED_COLLECTIONS protects 'backups' collection), single _create_backup function used by both manual and daily job. UI smoke test: login as Super Admin → /admin/backups → created manual snapshot 'ui-smoke-iter10' → clicked Restore on a backup → pre-restore safety snapshot auto-created at top of history.
action_items: Prior iteration regression test files (test_recharge_idempotency.py, test_agent_recharge_validation.py, test_billpay_tier_boundary.py, test_distributor_withdrawal_bug.py) ERROR at setup because their fixtures expect users test_dist_2a03f52a@x.com / test_agent_46a8e0d6@x.com that were wiped in iteration_9 (Erase Demo Data test). This is preexisting test-infra debt, NOT a regression from the backup fix. To restore green regression coverage, re-seed those users (or refactor those tests to create their own ephemeral users in setUp).

Optional polish: extend payload['files'] entries with an sha256 field so restore can verify byte-equality per file (today the manifest only counts files, not their hashes). Not blocking — defense in depth.
critical_code_review_comments: _dump_db_to_gz_bytes correctly uses bson.json_util for BSON-safe serialization — preserves ObjectId, datetime, Binary in nested fields.
BACKUP_EXCLUDED_COLLECTIONS is a SET (not allowlist) — new app collections are automatically included. Verified empirically with test_future_collection_iter10.
_create_backup is the sole backup writer — manual (line 1997), restore safety (lines 2028, 2061), and _daily_backup_job (line 1907) all call the same function. No drift possible.
Restore re-uploads file binaries via put_object BEFORE returning, then verifies counts. HTTP 409 path includes safety_backup_id so admin can roll back.

Minor: file_fetch_errors are logged into the manifest at backup time but the restore-side mismatch check only compares restored vs manifest['file_count'], so if a backup is taken while a file is missing from storage, the count will already be consistent and no warning surfaces at restore. Acceptable but worth a future enhancement to expose manifest['file_fetch_errors'] in the UI.
server.py is now 2114 lines — exceeds 700-line threshold from code-review guidelines. Suggest splitting backup module into /app/backend/modules/backup.py in a future iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup/restore is hardened and verified at iteration_10. Key insight: pytest CLI must inject REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL because /app pytest sessions don't auto-source frontend/.env. Use: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://fintech-bill-pay.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest ...`. The four older regression test files have hard-coded test_dist/test_agent emails that no longer exist post-iteration_9 — they need re-seeding before they can run green.
rca of the issue: Original bug had 3 root causes: (1) BACKUP_INCLUDED_COLLECTIONS was a hardcoded allowlist — any new collection added later was silently dropped at backup time; (2) the 'files' collection holds object-storage POINTERS only, so backing up just the docs left zero binary content captured (after Reset Demo Data + Restore the storage_path entries pointed at deleted blobs); (3) restore reported success even when collections/files were short. Fix in server.py L1693-1858 replaces the allowlist with a dynamic enumeration via db.list_collection_names() minus an EXCLUDED set, switches to bson.json_util for BSON-safe ser/de, fetches every file via get_object(storage_path) and base64-encodes into payload['files'], adds a manifest with per-collection counts + file_count, and verifies on restore — raising HTTP 409 with safety_backup_id on any mismatch. End-to-end SHA256 round-trip on a real PNG file proves byte equivalence (test_upload_backup_delete_restore_returns_same_bytes).
